This prototype does not upload or send your plan. You can review and download a copy yourself. When you visit another website, that website receives the request and its own privacy terms apply.
What happens on a shared phone?
Leave saving off. If you have enabled it, turn it off or clear your plan before someone else uses the browser. Downloaded copies remain in the phone’s files.
Does Lift make decisions about my eligibility?
No. This prototype provides a planning checklist. A programme or service provider must explain its own requirements and make its own decisions with an appropriate review process.
Are translation or AI services running here?
No translation, document processing or generative AI service is connected in this version. Burmese and Thai wording must be reviewed before release. This prototype makes no external AI requests.

A child's learning matters too. Prepare questions for a school, learning centre or trusted educator.
Which learning options could fit the child's age and current learning level, and who can explain enrolment requirements?
Which languages can the child use now, and what support is available for learning Thai while keeping their first language?
What short learning activities can a caregiver and child try together, and what schedule could fit the family?
Can activities work without a phone, with printed materials, or offline on a shared phone?
What are the costs for materials, travel, uniforms or other items, and is any help available?
What support is available if the child has difficulty seeing, hearing, moving, communicating or participating in learning?
